name: Tom Cotton

issue_poll.name: Arkansas Poll (University of Arkansas), Oct 9–21, 2020; plus Pew Research Center, July 27–Aug 2, 2020
issue_poll.note: Ranks 1–5 from the Arkansas Poll most-important-issue question (health care 23%, economy 23%, drugs 15%, education 9%, taxes/big government 6%; health care ranked first on very-likely-voter share 24% vs 23%; 'politicians/politics' 21% dropped as untestable).
